task-delivery.title: Delivery and quality
task-delivery.intro: Read current delivery facts for this task. This panel does not dispatch tools, run tests or submit acceptance.
task-delivery.origin.current.title: Original run verified
task-delivery.origin.current.detail: The linked run matches the current task binding.
task-delivery.origin.changed.title: Task bound to a different run
task-delivery.origin.changed.detail: The linked run differs from the current task binding. Open current delivery to review its evidence.
task-delivery.origin.unbound.title: Task has no bound run
task-delivery.origin.unbound.detail: This task has no current run binding. Open current delivery to check its status.
task-delivery.origin.unknown.title: Run binding could not be verified
task-delivery.origin.unknown.detail: Refresh the facts to check the original run again, or open current delivery.
task-delivery.origin.version_pending: Confirming the current task version before showing delivery evidence.
task-delivery.invalid_read: Delivery facts could not be verified for the selected task. Read them again before following evidence links.
task-delivery.access_changed: Access changed. Protected facts are hidden; retry to read with current access.
task-delivery.repair.title: Repair context
task-delivery.repair.regression_scope: This binding records the regression scope. Check test results separately.
task-delivery.graph_changed: The current task version differs from the graph snapshot. Refresh or compare the graph before dispatching.
task-delivery.basis.not_dispatched: No execution is bound to this task.
task-delivery.basis.current: Execution inputs match the current task basis.
task-delivery.basis.changed: Task inputs changed. The historical execution does not prove delivery of the current task.
task-delivery.basis.unknown: The execution basis could not be confirmed. Review the original run before continuing.
task-delivery.workbuddy.origin.title: WorkBuddy handoff source
task-delivery.repository_source.intro: Select a registered project target to read its current Git commit for this delivery attempt.
task-delivery.repository_source.empty: No active repository targets are available in this project.
task-delivery.repository_source.denied: Access is unavailable for this source check. Reload targets with current access.
task-delivery.repository_source.changed: The delivery attempt or repository target changed. Refresh delivery facts and select the current target.
task-delivery.repository_source.unavaila: The repository source could not be read. Try again when it is available.
task-delivery.repository_source.invalid: The repository response could not be verified for this attempt and target.
task-delivery.repository_source.boundary: This read identifies the repository commit. WorkBuddy authorship, candidate import, tests and acceptance require separate evidence.
task-delivery.repository_source.workbenc: The original action is awaiting confirmation. Recovery checks that same request and operation key.
Project approval permission is required to retain or dispatch a source.
The repository head and baseline are the same. There is no new candidate to retain.
The live repository basis is unavailable. Previously retained sources can still be selected.
The branch moved since the previous check. Review the updated source and baseline shown here.
I approve retaining this exact source commit and baseline.
The source is retained. Preview a plan to choose the import and independent test Workers.
Import seals the original Git bundle. A different Worker tests the same commit.
Close the active task terminal before previewing the plan.
Publish the task's test cases before previewing the plan.
Only the first available profiles are shown. Refresh after updating the project tools if the needed profile is missing.
No eligible import and test profiles are available on different Workers.
Import and tests are tracked in the new run. Formal acceptance follows the verified test results.
Starting binds the task to a new candidate run with separate import and independent test steps.
This plan is no longer ready. Refresh the task or prepare a new preview.
Start this exact plan and run the independent test.
task-delivery.test_boundary: These are test-node execution facts for the current run, not approval eligibility. Open evidence to inspect independent checks and the exact code candidate; child workflows are not a complete test summary here.
task-delivery.test_counts: {{total}} test nodes · {{passed}} succeeded · {{failed}} failed · {{pending}} pending or unknown
task-delivery.no_tests: No test nodes are recorded in this run. No test pass is inferred.
task-delivery.no_run: Bind an actual execution before inspecting its tests.
task-delivery.acceptance_boundary: Execution success and test results do not replace human acceptance. Current evidence and permissions are rechecked when an acceptance decision is submitted.
task-delivery.current_run_scope: Only references from this task's currently bound execution are shown.
task-delivery.no_plans: No team plan is linked to this bound execution. Undispatched previews are outside this view.
task-delivery.no_issues: No canonical failure or rejected-review issue is linked to this execution.
